landConverter.title: Nepali Land Unit Converter
landConverter.intro: Convert ropani, aana, paisa, daam, bigha, kattha and dhur to square feet, square metres and acres. Enter a value in any unit to see it in every other unit.
landConverter.invalid: Enter a number greater than zero.
landConverter.hillTableTitle: Hill system (Kathmandu Valley and hill districts)
landConverter.hillTableIntro: Ropani, aana, paisa and daam are used for land in the Kathmandu Valley and most hill districts. 1 ropani = 16 aana, 1 aana = 4 paisa and 1 paisa = 4 daam.
landConverter.teraiTableIntro: Bigha, kattha and dhur are used in the Terai, for example in Chitwan, Rupandehi, Morang and Kailali. 1 bigha = 20 kattha and 1 kattha = 20 dhur.
landConverter.compareText: One bigha is about {{ropaniPerBigha}} ropani, and one ropani is about {{katthaPerRopani}} kattha. One ropani is roughly {{acrePerRopani}} acres.

pair.title: {{from}} to {{to}} Converter
pair.formulaMultiply: To convert {{from}} to {{to}}, multiply the number of {{from}} by {{factor}}. For example, {{amount}} × {{factor}} = {{value}} {{resultUnit}}.
pair.formulaDivide: To convert {{from}} to {{to}}, divide the number of {{from}} by {{divisor}}. For example, {{amount}} ÷ {{divisor}} = {{value}} {{resultUnit}}.

landConverter.calculatorLink: Know the length and breadth? Calculate the land area

areaCalculator.title: Land Area Calculator
areaCalculator.intro: Enter the length and breadth of a plot in feet or metres to get its area in square feet, aana, ropani-aana-paisa-daam and bigha-kattha-dhur. For a plot with uneven sides, enter all four sides.
areaCalculator.unevenNote: Estimate: the averages of each pair of opposite sides, multiplied together. Close for nearly rectangular plots; a surveyor (amin) can give the exact area.
areaCalculator.invalid: Enter a number greater than zero for every side.
areaCalculator.howRectangle: Multiply the length by the breadth. A {{length}} × {{breadth}} feet plot is {{sqft}} square feet. One aana is {{aanaSqft}} square feet, so {{sqft}} ÷ {{aanaSqft}} = {{aana}} aana ({{hill}} in ropani-aana-paisa-daam).
areaCalculator.howMetres: If you measured in metres, multiply the area in square metres by {{factor}} to get square feet.
areaCalculator.howUneven: For a plot whose opposite sides differ, average each pair of opposite sides and multiply the two averages.
